# IA drift review — `05-stress-ia-drift`

12 findings, no high. One genuine correctness risk; everything else is hygiene of varying urgency.

## Blocking-quality (fix before merge)

**`crime_00001` — Permission IA Drift on `/admin`** (medium, conf 0.7)
Three different role tokens (`admin`, `manager`, `owner`) gate the same destination across `src/nav.ts:6`, `src/routes/admin.ts:2-9`, and `docs/routes.md`. This is the only finding with real correctness/security implications — a stale token here is an auth bug, not a typo. The fix shape (centralise the check, route every caller through it) is also the cheapest of the bunch. Resolve before merging.

## Strong follow-ups (next sprint, not the merge bar)

- **`crime_00006` — Parallel Destination `/admin/billing-plans` vs `/billing-plans`** (medium, conf 0.6). Two route files sharing `billing`+`plan` tokens with no nav/doc/import link between them. Decide canonical + redirect, or document the deliberate split. Borderline blocker if either is user-facing today; pure follow-up if both are dead (see orphan findings below — they are).
- **`crime_00004` — Concept Alias Drift on "tenant"** (medium, conf 0.75). `organisation` / `team` / `workspace` co-exist across 5 files. Pick one canonical term; will keep biting until done.
- **`crime_00002` — Missing Agent Context** (medium, conf 0.9). Add `AGENTS.md` / `SKILL.md` so future agents discover the `iaq` bin and conventions. Cheap; high leverage on this exact class of drift recurring.

## Housekeeping (batch when convenient)

- **`crime_00003`** broken doc link to `/admin` in `docs/routes.md:14`.
- **`crime_00005`** docs reference retired commands `iaq teams|workspace|refresh` (advertised bin is `get, list`).
- **`crime_00007-00010`** four orphan routes (`/admin/billing-plans`, `/billing-plans`, `/organisation`, `/workspace`) — unreachable from nav, docs, or imports. Note these collectively answer the parallel-destination question: both billing-plans routes are dead, so #6 collapses to a delete.
- **`crime_00011` + `crime_00012`** action-label drift (`archive`/`delete`/`remove`) across SeatList/TeamList/UserList. These two findings describe the same root cause; treat as one fix.

## One-line recommendation

Block on `crime_00001`; pair-fix `crime_00006` with the orphan cleanup (`00007-00010`) since they resolve each other; everything else is a follow-up PR.
